_comment: Difficulty presets, transcribed from DIFFICULTIES in main.py.
Every knob a difficulty can turn lives in one record, so tuning Hard is
editing numbers here rather than hunting through the codebase.
scale      multiplies enemy health and damage scaling
headstart  extra effective waves a boss spawns with
speed      FLAT multiplier on every enemy's base movement speed
hpCurve    multiplies the per-tier health growth (1.60 = +60% a tier)
bossFire   boss projectile interval multiplier (0.50 = twice as fast)
eliteHorn  Challenge Horn calls in elites instead of a mixed mob
grabCd     seconds the cursor must wait between grabs

difficulties.label: EASY
difficulties.blurb: Enemies scale 20% slower, walk 10% slower, you earn 15% more gold, and the cursor never has to wait between grabs.

difficulties.label: NORMAL
difficulties.blurb: The game as designed. Standard scaling, standard pay, a quarter-second between grabs.

difficulties.label: HARD
difficulties.blurb: Enemies move 40% faster, health scales 60% harder per tier, bosses fire twice as fast, the horn calls in elites, and every grab costs you half a second.
